fullPassage:
Choosing a career is one of the biggest life decisions young people face. Mapping out the right career path can be demanding. While some teenagers have a clear vision of their career goals, others struggle to define them. This is where role models can be useful. They help young people start to plan their careers by providing them with guidance and the sense of purpose they need to succeed. We asked our teenage readers about their role models and the qualities they admire most in them. After you read each student's story, you will get a better idea of the profound impact role models can have when it comes to shaping career goals.

My role model is Jacques Cousteau, a famous ocean explorer. As a young boy, Cousteau was involved in a serious car accident, and doctors told him he might never use his arms again. However, he refused to give up. Following his doctors' advice, he started swimming as a way to strengthen his arms. It was during this recovery that he became intrigued by the underwater world. At the time, diving equipment was insufficient for deep exploration. This challenge inspired Cousteau to co-invent the Aqua-Lung, a device that allowed divers to breathe underwater for extended periods. He also produced a famous documentary that opened people's eyes to the beauty and fragility of ocean life. Cousteau became a leading figure in marine conservation. What I admire most about him is his curiosity and passion for pushing beyond boundaries.

My role model is Joan Beauchamp Procter, a pioneering British zoologist who devoted her life to the study of reptiles. From a young age, Procter showed a deep devotion to animals, especially reptiles. She was so immersed in her studies that she often brought her pet reptiles to school. Despite suffering from serious health problems throughout her life, she never let them hold her back. Procter gained extensive knowledge of reptiles, and at the age of just sixteen, she began exchanging letters with George Albert Boulenger, one of the most respected zoologists of that era. Impressed by her knowledge, Boulenger encouraged her to pursue a career in zoology. She went on to become the curator of the Reptile House at the London Zoo, where she transformed it into a world-class facility by incorporating technology and innovative design.

My role model is Kim Sang-jin, a Korean animator who worked at Disney. From a young age, Kim was enthusiastic about drawing and dreamed of becoming an animator. However, he was diagnosed with color vision deficiency, which disrupted his plans. Many people tried to discourage him from pursuing art, but he refused to give up. Instead, he earned an economics degree while continuing to develop his drawing skills. He built an impressive portfolio and eventually landed a position at Walt Disney Studios. What I admire most about Kim is his persistence and positive attitude. He never let obstacles define his future.

These stories show us the importance of having role models. Whether it is Cousteau's curiosity, Procter's devotion, or Kim's persistence, each of them demonstrates qualities that can inspire us. Their commitment and optimism teach us that career exploration is a journey, not a destination. Role models remind us that with hard work and dedication, we can achieve our goals.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

det.ref: 원문: role models can have
det.correct: ⓒ had → have: 조동사 can 뒤에 동사원형이 와야 한다. can + have(동사원형).

❌ ① providing: by + 동명사 구조로 정상.
❌ ② admire: 주어 they(readers)에 대한 동사원형으로 정상.
❌ ④ shaping: when it comes to + 동명사 구조로 정상.

wrongs: ⓐ immersed: be immersed in(~에 몰두하다) 정상
det.tip: 사역동사(let/make/have) + 목적어 + 동사원형! let them to hold(X) → let them hold(O). cf. allow/enable은 to부정사를 취한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ to hold → hold: let은 사역동사이므로 'let + 목적어 + 동사원형' 구조. to부정사가 올 수 없다.
❌ ① immersed: be immersed in(~에 몰두하다) 정상.
❌ ② suffering: despite + 동명사 정상.
❌ ④ exchanging: begin + 동명사 정상.

det.ref: 원문: persistence and positive attitude

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

These stories show us the importance of __________ role models.

det.correct: having(동명사): 전치사 of 뒤에 동명사가 와야 한다.
wrongs: to have had(완료부정사): of 뒤에 to부정사 부적절
det.tip: 전치사(of) + 동명사(-ing): the importance of having(가지는 것의 중요성). 전치사 뒤에는 명사/동명사만 올 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ having: 전치사 of 뒤에 동명사가 와야 한다. the importance of having(갖는 것의 중요성).
❌ ① have: 전치사 뒤에 동사원형 불가.
❌ ③ had: 전치사 뒤에 과거형 불가.
❌ ② to have had: of 뒤에 to부정사(완료형) 부적절.

questions.passage: My role model is Joan Beauchamp Procter, a pioneering British zoologist who devoted her life to the study of reptiles. From a young age, Procter showed a deep devotion to animals, especially reptiles. She was so immersed in her studies that she often brought her pet reptiles to school. Despite suffering from serious health problems throughout her life, she never let them hold her back. Procter gained extensive knowledge of reptiles, and at the age of just sixteen, she began exchanging letters with George Albert Boulenger, one of the most respected zoologists of that era. __________ by her knowledge, Boulenger encouraged her to pursue a career in zoology. She went on to become the curator of the Reptile House at the London Zoo.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: 원문: Impressed by her knowledge
det.correct: Impressed(과거분사): 분사구문에서 주어(Boulenger)가 '감명을 받은' 상태이므로 수동(과거분사)이 적절.
wrongs: Impressing(현재분사): 주어가 감명을 주는 것이 아니라 받는 것
Being impressed: 문법적으로 가능하나 원문은 Impressed
det.tip: 감정 분사: Impressed(감명 받은, 수동) vs Impressing(감명을 주는, 능동). 주어 Boulenger가 감명을 받은 것이므로 과거분사 Impressed가 적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① Impressed: 분사구문에서 주어 Boulenger가 '감명을 받은' 상태이므로 수동(과거분사).
❌ ② Impressing: 주어가 감명을 주는 것이 아니라 받는 것이므로 부적절.
❌ ③ Being impressed: 문법적으로 가능하나 간결한 Impressed가 원문.
❌ ④ Having impressing: having + 현재분사는 비문.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ, ⓑ의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: 원문: profound impact, shaping career goals
det.correct: ✅ ① profound(깊은, 심오한) + shaping(형성하는): 원문 의미 일치
det.tip: profound = deep, significant(깊은, 심오한). shaping = forming, molding(형성하는). 진로 목표를 '형성'하는 데 '깊은' 영향.
det.analysis:
✅ ① ⓐ 깊은 — ⓑ 형성하는: profound = 깊은/심오한, shaping = 형성하는. 원문 의미 정확히 일치.
❌ ② ⓐ 사소한: profound의 반의어(trivial). 원문과 반대.
❌ ③ ⓑ 파괴하는: shaping(형성)과 반대 의미(destroying).
❌ ④ 둘 다 원문과 반대 의미.

As a young boy, Cousteau was involved in a serious car accident, and doctors told him he might never use his arms again. __________, he refused to give up. Following his doctors' advice, he started swimming as a way to strengthen his arms. It was during this recovery that he became intrigued by the underwater world. At the time, diving equipment was insufficient for deep exploration. This challenge inspired Cousteau to co-invent the Aqua-Lung, a device that allowed divers to breathe underwater for extended periods. He also produced a famous documentary that opened people's eyes to the beauty and fragility of ocean life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 연결사로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: 원문: However, he refused to give up
det.correct: ✅ ② However: 의사가 팔을 다시 사용할 수 없다고 했지만(역접), 포기하지 않았다.
det.tip: However(그러나) = 역접 연결사. 앞 내용(팔 사용 불가 가능성)과 뒤 내용(포기 거부)이 대조를 이룬다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ However: 의사가 팔을 다시 사용할 수 없다고 했지만(역접), 포기하지 않았다는 내용.
❌ ① Therefore: 인과관계(그러므로)가 아님. 팔 사용 불가 → 포기 거부는 순접이 아니라 역접.
❌ ③ Moreover: 추가 정보(게다가)가 아님.
❌ ② Similarly: 유사 관계(마찬가지로)가 아님.

questions.passage: My role model is Kim Sang-jin, a Korean animator who worked at Disney. From a young age, Kim was enthusiastic about drawing and dreamed of becoming an animator. However, he was diagnosed with color vision deficiency, which disrupted his plans. Many people tried to discourage him from pursuing art, but he refused to give up. __________, he earned an economics degree while continuing to develop his drawing skills. He built an impressive portfolio and eventually landed a position at Walt Disney Studios. What I admire most about Kim is his persistence and positive attitude. He never let obstacles define his future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 연결사로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: 원문: Instead, he earned an economics degree
det.correct: ✅ ③ Instead: 포기하는 대신(Instead), 경제학 학위를 취득하며 그림 실력을 계속 키웠다.
wrongs: ① Nevertheless(그럼에도): 역접이지만 대안 제시가 아님
② For example(예를 들어): 예시 아님
④ In addition(게다가): 단순 추가 아님, 대안 제시임
det.tip: Instead(대신에) = 앞의 행동을 하지 않고 다른 행동을 선택할 때. 포기(give up)하지 않고 '대신' 경제학 학위를 땄다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② Instead: 포기하는 대신 경제학 학위를 취득하며 그림 실력을 계속 키웠다. 대안 제시.
❌ ① Nevertheless: 역접이지만 대안 제시의 의미가 아님.
❌ ③ For example: 예시 관계가 아님.
❌ ④ In addition: 단순 추가가 아닌 대안 제시 맥락.

questions.stem: 위 글의 Cousteau에 관한 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 수중 호흡 장치인 아쿠아렁을 공동 발명했다.
다큐멘터리를 보고 해양 탐험에 관심을 갖게 되었다.

det.ref: 원문: co-invent the Aqua-Lung, a device that allowed divers to breathe underwater
det.correct: ✅ ③ 아쿠아렁을 공동 발명(co-invent)했다 — 원문 직접 언급
wrongs: ① 수영 사고가 아니라 자동차 사고(car accident)
④ 다큐멘터리를 '제작(produced)'했지 보고 관심을 가진 것이 아님
det.tip: co-invent = 공동 발명하다. co-(함께) + invent(발명하다). Aqua-Lung은 수중 호흡 장치.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 아쿠아렁을 공동 발명(co-invent)했다: 원문에 직접 언급.
❌ ① 수영 사고가 아니라 자동차 사고(car accident).
❌ ③ 의사의 조언을 무시한 것이 아니라 '따라서(Following)' 수영을 시작함.
❌ ④ 다큐멘터리를 '제작(produced)'했지 보고 관심을 가진 것이 아님.

These stories show us the importance of having role models. Whether it is Cousteau's curiosity, Procter's devotion, or Kim's persistence, each of them demonstrates qualities that can inspire us. Their commitment and optimism teach us that career exploration is a journey, not a destination. Role models remind us that with hard work and dedication, we can achieve our goals.

det.ref: 원문: he refused to give up
det.correct: ✅ F: Kim은 색각 이상 진단 후에도 꿈을 포기하지 않았다. 오히려 경제학 학위를 받으면서도 그림 실력을 계속 발전시켰다.

It was during this recovery that he became <u>② bored with</u> the underwater world. At the time, diving equipment was <u>③ insufficient</u> for deep exploration. det.ref: 원문: became intrigued by the underwater world

det.tip: intrigued by(~에 흥미를 느끼는) ↔ bored with(~에 지루해하는). 전치사도 다르다: intrigued by vs bored with.
det.analysis:
✅ ① bored with → intrigued by: '지루해하는'이 아니라 '흥미를 느끼는'이 원문.
❌ ② strengthen: 원문과 동일.
❌ ③ insufficient: 원문과 동일.
❌ ④ inspired: 원문과 동일.

det.ref: 원문: one of the most respected zoologists

wrongs: ① hold: 원문 일치 (let them hold her back)
det.tip: respected(존경받는) ↔ disrespected(존경받지 못한). dis-(부정 접두사) + respected. Boulenger는 가장 존경받는 동물학자 중 한 명이었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② disrespected → respected: '존경받지 못한'이 아니라 '존경받는'이 원문.
❌ ① hold: 원문과 동일 (let them hold her back).
❌ ③ extensive: 원문과 동일.
